summary:
• LFM2.5‑24B‑A2B — a 24‑billion‑parameter reasoning model that activates only two billion parameters per token, enabling fast, private on‑device assistants with 131 K token context and explicit chain‑of‑thought.
• Claude Code — Anthropic's development extension for VS Code that adds inline virtual‑text hints, OpenTelemetry cache metrics, RTL support, and an /advisor command for quick assistance.
• Folkbench Switch — a Tauri‑Rust desktop client that lets users toggle between AI proxy endpoints with one click, displaying live rankings for stability, latency, price and security.
• New‑term‑radar — a daily scraper that monitors social feeds for emerging AI model, product or repository names, delivering early‑signal tables for content creators to gain first‑mover advantage.
• Amp — a platform that wraps OpenAI’s latest agents, like GPT‑6 Astra and GPT‑Live‑1, into ready pipelines for scheduling, inventory and customer‑service automation.
• Tree Appreciator — a tiny three‑js web game generated by Claude that lets players compare algorithmically grown trees, showcasing LLM‑driven rapid prototyping of interactive visual content.
